capabilities.reason: live-study check pi.live.study; supersedes pi.local.state; limits: Continuity holds once the session was persisted, which Pi does at its first message

local-protocol check pi.local.entries-cursor; limits: Entry ids are opaque: order comes only from Pi's append order, never from the ids Abandoned branches are included in get_entries; the leaf id identifies the active branch

local-protocol check pi.local.tree; limits: The context-window boundary is derived from compaction entries (firstKeptEntryId), not reported directly The active tool names of Continuity v0 are not available over RPC
local-protocol check pi.local.state; limits: One session per process and no lanes No operation id, kind or start time for the active run

local-protocol check pi.local.stats; limits: Cost is a total only: no input/output/cache cost breakdown No reasoning-token or one-hour cache-write counts in the stats (they appear per entry when the provider reports them)
local-protocol check pi.local.controls; limits: Exercised by re-selecting the configured model; switching to another model is not exercised (it may need other credentials)
local-protocol check pi.local.controls; limits: Only one thinking level is available for the configured model, so no change was exercised
local-protocol check pi.local.controls; limits: Pi's extension API (pi.getActiveTools/pi.setActiveTools) could provide this through an optional extension; none is installed by Endophasia

live-study check pi.live.study; limits: No run or turn identifiers: events are ordered by arrival only No resume or suspend events (Mission Trace v0 mission.resumed/suspended are unavailable) Live events are not replayed by Pi: after a reconnect only durable entries can be caught up

live-study check pi.live.study; limits: Usage is what the provider reported; a provider that reports none yields zeros, not an estimate Rows are keyed by opaque entry ids, not by an integer ledger sequence
live-study check pi.live.study; limits: Whether a model calls a tool is the model's choice: an absent call is inconclusive, not a failure

live-study check pi.live.study; limits: Pi's acceptance carries no identity for the queued message: a receipt cannot be correlated with its consumption except by content queue_update reports the queued texts, not identities

live-study check pi.live.study; limits: Pi's acceptance carries no identity for the queued message: a receipt cannot be correlated with its consumption except by content queue_update reports the queued texts, not identities

live-study check pi.live.study; limits: Pi's abort takes no target: it aborts whatever is current and cannot be confined to the run the operator observed The acknowledgement is not the outcome; the ended run is observed separately
live-study check pi.live.study; agrees with pi.baseline.surface-review=UNAVAILABLE; limits: Endophasia does not invent run ids: mapped events carry no run coordinate

live-study check pi.live.study; agrees with pi.baseline.surface-review=UNAVAILABLE; limits: Acceptance (the response) and effects (later events and entries) stay separate records; no outcome is inferred
